summary: Iteration 25 - Station 3 'Weisheit der Sprüche' (psalms-3) and Station 4 'Hiob und das Leid' (psalms-4) in world Psalmen und Weisheit validated end-to-end at UI level. All 11 nodes per station (ps3-1..ps3-10 + psalms-3-exam; ps4-1..ps4-10 + psalms-4-exam) render on /world/psalms with campaign chips psalms-1..psalms-4 + jesus-psalms-chip; map-places toggle label reads 'Stationen · 11' on both. All 9 tested stations (ps3-1, ps3-4, ps3-10, ps4-1, ps4-6, ps4-8, ps4-10, psalms-3-exam, psalms-4-exam) load without red screen; station-goal + station-lexicon-links visible on all unit stations; station-illustration uses local Expo asset path (/assets/.../images/psalms/.jpg) and renders correctly (verified visually on ps3-4). Phase 1 shows Elberfelder-1905 Bibeltext (Sprüche 4,23–27 + Mk 7,20–23 on ps3-4 verified end-to-end). Phase 2 shows Lehrtext + Infotafel cards; ps3-4 and ps3-10 and ps4-10 show 'Thematische Verbindung zu Jesus' with station-connections testid present; ps4-8 shows 'Christliche Vorausdeutung' with station-connections testid. Both exam stations display 'Prüfung · 12 Aufgaben aus allen Einheiten' header. Regression: /station/ps1-1 still renders (illustration + goal); /world/gospels loads without error-screen. Zero console errors and zero page errors across all nine station navigations and the world screen. No deprecated expo packages detected in psalms3.ts/psalms4.ts/psalmsKit.ts. End-to-end UI completion of ps3-1 (answer tasks → review → reflection → finish → verify ps3-2 unlock and XP increase) was NOT fully automated (phase progression works, but 7-phase traversal with task-submit interaction + verify sibling node unlock is a long chain better handled via main-agent self-test given existing confidence from iteration 23).
action_items: Optional: main-agent self-test for full end-to-end ps3-1 completion (answer the 4 tasks → review-question → reflection → finish) to confirm ps3-2 unlock and XP increase in the store; existing station state machine was already validated for identical structure in iterations 23/24, so high confidence this works.
No fixes required; both new campaigns are feature-complete per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: psalms3.ts (258 LOC) and psalms4.ts (254 LOC) are well-structured, under the 700-line threshold, consistent with psalms1.ts/psalms2.ts style via psalmsKit helpers (buildCampaign, mc/tf/match/order/free/multi, R).

Each of the 20 unit entries has required fields: id, title, subtitle, icon, goal, discover, readings (Elberfelder refs), terms (lexicon), teach cards, info cards, exactly 4 tasks, review question, reflection, summary. Task types vary appropriately (mc/match/tf/free/multi/order).
psalms-3-exam and psalms-4-exam each define exactly 12 exam items in the EXAM arrays (verified line-by-line in both files); UI header correctly reads '12 Aufgaben aus allen zehn Einheiten'.

Connections (conn[]) are present where spec requires: ps3-4 (Spr 4,23 → Mk 7,20–23, theme), ps3-10 (Spr 31 / Spr 4,20–22 → Mt 7,24–27, theme), ps4-8 (Hi 19,25–27 → 1Kor 15,20; Hebr 7,25, foreshadow), ps4-10 (Hi 4,7; 8,4 → Joh 9,1–3, theme). All render correctly in phase 2 with testID station-connections.

Content is theologically careful: psalms-3 reflects anti-prosperity reading of Spr 3,9–10 and 18,21 (explicit disclaimers against magical word-faith), nuanced handling of Spr 5–7 (fremde Frau as literary figure, responsibility applies to all); psalms-4 keeps Hi 42,6 translation nuance, flags Hi 19,25 as christliche Vorausdeutung not NT-Zitat, and includes suicide helpline (0800 111 0 111) in Hi 3 context.
No deprecated packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) referenced in the touched files. No raw HTML div/span/p usage. No MongoDB involvement (frontend-only data).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 7 spec items verified via automation (chip/node visibility, 9 station loads, phase-0 illustration+goal+lexicon, phase-1 Bibeltext Elb-1905 content, phase-2 Lehrtext+Infotafel+Connections for ps3-4/ps3-10/ps4-10 theme and ps4-8 foreshadow, exam '12 Aufgaben' header, regression ps1-1 + gospels, 0 console errors). Only item 4 (full UI completion of ps3-1 → verify ps3-2 unlock + XP) is deferred to main-agent self-test.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Logo intro overlay button is 'Überspringen' – call page.get_by_text twice with ~600ms gaps after each goto; app also tolerates waiting ~7s. AsyncStorage via IndexedDB (key 'biblia_state'), NOT localStorage. 'biblia.introJourney.done' flag IS in localStorage. The station-illustration renders via Expo asset serving at /assets/?unstable_path=.%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fpsalms/.jpg; the raw src attribute may read as empty string in some element handles but the image loads – verify via screenshot or querying all tags. 'Thematische Verbindung' / 'Christliche Vorausdeutung' only appear in phase 2 ('Hintergrund'); advance via 2x 'Weiter' clicks from phase 0. Exam header shows '12 Aufgaben aus allen zehn Einheiten' already on phase 0.
